SQL:
WITH affected AS (
 SELECT dst_id AS other_id, src_id AS cr_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC
 UNION SELECT dst_id,src_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC
 UNION SELECT dst_id,src_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_OM_SPEC
)
SELECT s.specNumber AS affectedSpec, COUNT(DISTINCT c.node_id) AS crCount
FROM Spec s JOIN affected a ON a.other_id=s.node_id JOIN CR c ON c.node_id=a.cr_id
WHERE s.specNumber IS NOT NULL AND s.specNumber<>'38.214'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rel_MODIFIES m JOIN Spec main ON main.node_id=m.dst_id WHERE m.src_id=c.node_id AND main.specNumber='38.214')
GROUP BY s.specNumber ORDER BY crCount DESC, affectedSpec ASC
strategy: Start from other Spec and role-union incidence, then EXISTS qualifying primary modification; unlike CR-first double-match reference. UNION and COUNT DISTINCT preserve role and node multiplicity.
